---
title: "Task Tutorials"
---

Each tutorial is a runnable end-to-end workflow on the
[demo dataset](../demo-data/index.qmd). Tutorials show **both packages**
side by side where applicable.

| Task | Methods covered |
|---|---|
| [Genomic Prediction](genomic-prediction.qmd) | GBLUP (`masreml`), BayesA / BayesR (`masbayes`) |
| [GWAS](gwas.qmd) | `masreml::run_gwas`, BayesR variable selection |
| [GWABLUP](gwablup.qmd) | weight-then-predict using GWAS p-values |
| [Cross-validation](cross-validation.qmd) | `masreml::cv_masreml` |
| [Binary trait analysis](binary-trait.qmd) | threshold model with `masreml` |
